contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
DN ARCADIVS PF AVG ; VIRTVS ROMANORVM

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, silver, siliqua of Arcadius (383-408AD). Obverse: Pearl diadem, draped and cuirassed bust right. Inscription: DN ARCADIVS PF AVG. Reverse: Roma seated left on cuirass holding Victory on globe and reversed spear or sceptre. Inscription: VIRTVS ROMANORVM. Mint name: Milan (Italy). Mint mark: -//MDPS. Reece period 21. Die axis: 12 o'clock. This coin is in very fine condition with very little wear, struck on an oval flan. It has a good silver coloured surface with no tarnish. This coin is likely to date to 395-402AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 65, Roman Silver Coins Vol V, First edition, Seaby 1987, page 180 no. 276 and RIC VOL. X,…
